Episode 247. Liberation War of Laprarosa (4)
Tsuuuaaaa…!
From the rift, it seemed as if waves were pouring out. A deep blue aura, deeper than any wave energy, was covering the spot where Shimat had been.

Given that it crossed dimensions, it did not fully display the destructive power that Ban inherently possessed. Nonetheless, relying solely on the protection of the red wave energy was out of the question.
Shimat gritted his teeth, staring intently at the rift.
Even without having seen Ban in person, Shimat felt as if her intense face was right before him.
Moreover, a realization dawned on him.

‘...Weaker than before. Not fully refined to the extreme, and the fury is blatantly embedded in the wild sword energy. Is this due to the chaos affecting the being called Lingling, as Loki Ganesto said?’
As these thoughts crossed his mind, suddenly, the sword energy pouring out of the rift turned into a murky black hue.
[KAHAAAAAAK!]
A dark, eerie scream characteristic of chaotic beings echoed. Upon hearing this, Jin and the Kings gasped in shock.
'Lingling...!'
It was Lingling's scream. Despite the distance between dimensions, Lingling seemed to be crying out right in the middle of the battlefield.
Just hearing it conveyed a sense of agonizing pain. Despite the closeness of the sound, Jin was unable to sense Lingling's inner state, unlike usual.
The chaos was causing Lingling to go berserk. Therefore, communicating with Lingling or attempting to fuse with her, as they did on the deserted island in the past, was now impossible.
Crack!
Jin pulled out the blade he had embedded in the central top of Rital. With that, the top armor crumbled like dry husk, and Murakan's Dark Arrival seeped through.
Shimat quickly made a decision. Rather than recklessly using the Red Divine Sword towards Lapralosa again, it was better to first prevent the air fortress from being destroyed.
The crimson beam of the Red Heaven Sword began to pour down on Rital. At the same time, Pibil and Bessel aimed their cannons at Rital's top. Jin was still at the top of Rital.
If he just dodged, the enemy's attack would directly hit Rital. However, Jin believed the enemy wouldn't act so thoughtlessly.
As he anticipated, both the Red Divine Sword's beam and the cannons changed their trajectories to chase after him as soon as he dodged.
Moreover, the sword energy that Shimat shot again sliced off the Dark Arrival that had corroded Rital. Rital rapidly floated up and regained its position.
'As expected, it's not called the strongest war weapon of ancient times for no reason.'
In ancient times, countless powerful beings had knelt or perished before the Red Plutonian. The airborne fortress itself was virtually invincible, let alone with a Battle God like Shimat present.
Moreover, the Red Plutonian’s most powerful airborne fortress has not even made an appearance in the desert yet.
'If things go on like this, they will eventually bring out that Kri airborne fortress. Before that happens, I must rescue my brothers...!'
For Laprarosa, for the Bamel Alliance, and for the world.
It wasn't something Jin could do alone. Rather, the most certain keys now were Qwaul's device and LingLing.
[Keuhaaaaa-!]
LingLing's screams continued to resonate.
And every time Lingling suffered, the sword energy of Ban emerging from the rift became more erratic. It meant Ban's might was diminishing due to Lingling's influence.
While blocking Shimat's sword, Jin pondered what he could do for LingLing.
'Perhaps.'
Like LingLing, he thought that being consumed by chaos might also be a way for him.
'If I get consumed by chaos, I might be able to communicate with it. It must be lost in the chaos right now.'
Of course, it was a dangerous gamble. In the past, when consumed by the 'First Chaos', Jin lost all his power and struggled with LingLing for a while.
But now was different.
Jin had ascended to Genesis rank and knew much more about the nature of chaos than before. He thought he might be able to harness its power while being consumed by it.
And soon, his thoughts turned into conviction.
'If I hesitate now and something happens to LingLing, there won't be a next time. The entrance to Laprarosa will be closed forever.'
Even if it doesn't close, due to the aftereffects of LingLing's rampage, Ban would undoubtedly suffer fatal damage.
Irrecoverable injury, or even death.
The worst scenario might be Ban also going berserk and turning her own sword against her siblings. If they couldn't stop LingLing's rampage, anything could happen.
The brothers could endure it.
Until now, Jin had thought so, and it would be true. Ban and the Battle Kings wouldn't die just because they couldn't withstand external attacks.
But not LingLing. The LingLing that Jin and the Battle Kings knew wasn't that strong. A small, immature, and weak life.
In essence, she was no different from a child. There was no way such a LingLing could withstand the chaos on her own.
"Murakan, I won't be able to focus on the fight for a while. So, defend against Shimat and protect me during that time."
[Kid, what are you talking about all of a sudden?]
"I'm going to accept the chaos. I need to save LingLing."
[All of a sudden!?]
"Then, I'm counting on you."
Murakan looked back and forth in disbelief between Jin and the battlefield before nodding.

It was a look he hadn't seen in a long time. Full of determination, persistence, and madness. After all, he couldn't stop him, and looking back, Jin always managed to achieve the best outcome in such moments.
[Well, it's what a guardian dragon should do. I get it, just do your thing without worries. But when you come back, don't interrupt my time with strawberry pie.]
"Why are you blabbering during a fight? Jin Runkandel, Black Dragon. Have you already let your guard down just because you dealt some damage to Rital?"
Shimat closed the distance between them, slashing through the Darkness.
At that moment, Jin suddenly reached out to a small portion of darkness in front of him. It was still the chaotic energy spreading throughout the battlefield.
"It's not that, but your crying is a bit annoying."
"What? No, what are you...?!"
Shimart's eyes widened.
It was because Jin struck his own chest with the hand that grasped the chaos. Precisely where the glowing heart was. Even Shimat, the enemy, was momentarily taken aback, almost shouting in surprise.
Shimart knew very well how those engulfed in chaos changed. Thus, he couldn't help but think Jin was suddenly attempting suicide.
"Afraid of chaos, Shimat?"
Jin looked at Shimat and grinned slyly. Shimat kept his gaze fixed on Jin's heart, which darkened with every passing second.
"....Seeing it now, it seems you're more scared than I am. Did you throw a gamble to calm down that chaotic being called LingLing?"
"As expected, you're insightful. Then I'll be off, enjoy your time with Murakan."
"You're mad."
"I'd appreciate it if you'd describe it as decisiveness rather than madness."
Swish-! Shimat's sword lunged towards Jin's neck. Jin's reaction speed had already slowed, and he couldn't accurately predict the trajectory of the sword.
Instead, Murakan swung his tail, altering the direction of the sword. The red sword passed by the right side of Jin's head, missing it.
[Are you deaf? He said to have a good time with me.]
"Without Jin Runkandel, you think you can face me alone......"
From the moment Shimar responded, Jin felt his consciousness becoming foggy. The voice right in front of him echoed as if it were distant.
Though he said, "I'll be back," he was referring to his inner world. Jin remained on the battlefield.
Shimar's sword strikes and the aerial fortress's bombardments continuously rained down. Now, to Jin's vision, all those attacks merely looked like blurred beams of light.

After all, in the great desert, there was nowhere to hide from the eyes of the Red Plutonian. No matter how quickly one moved, it was impossible to outpace the mobility of the aerial fortress, and neither could one withstand its firepower. This was the best option.
His vision was becoming increasingly blurred. As the boundary between reality and the inner world crumbled, Jin realized an unexpected truth.
'I don’t feel any discomfort at all.'
He had assumed that being consumed by chaos would bring agonizing pain. However, Jin felt as if he was relaxing in warm water.
From the center of his chest, something warm was glowing. Looking down, he saw that it was his own radiant heart.
In reality, it was tainted by the darkness of chaos, but in his inner world, the luminous heart shone like a chunk of gold.
Jin instinctively knew when he saw this. The power he obtained from regeneration and creation was protecting him.
'I expected some comfort, but not to this extent.'
However, there was no telling how long this state would last. Besides, outside, Murakan and the brothers would be battling, so he had to finish quickly and return.
Now, a shimmering white desert stretched before his eyes. A sight he had encountered several times when transitioning between his inner world and the past, Jin began to walk familiarly.
'LingLing, where are you?'
There was no answer, but from afar, he heard a sound like a child sobbing. It was the cry of LingLing.
As he began to move towards the sound, dark areas tainted by chaos came into view. In the center of them, LingLing lay as if turned to stone.
Chaos swirled nearby.
'Do I have to cut through?'
There was no need. As Jin approached LingLing, the chaotic whirlwind faded and purified into a golden light, as if confronted by an undeniable presence.
Whoosh!
As the murkiness of the chaos cleared, LingLing gasped for breath and slowly raised her head.
'Jin...! Is it really you!?'
'Yes, it's me.'
'Now that you're here, ahem! Not like this. Since you arrived, I've been able to breathe more easily. What happened? You must have struggled because of me.'
As expected, Ban was enduring the aftermath of LingLing's rampage.
'Can you check Ban's condition right now?'
‘Yeah, it seems to have calmed down now. Ban's murderous aura isfading. But where is this? It doesn't seem like Lafrarosa or the human world."

'It's my inner world. I intentionally let myself be consumed by chaos to find you. Let's get out of here now. Ban is getting better, and you seemed to have been drawn out of Laprarosa by the chaos... Now we can fight together.'
Jin closed his eyes, focusing once again on the sounds of reality. As he felt the increasingly clear tumult of the battlefield and opened his eyes, he saw the red-tinted great desert.
